reconciliation: Open lines 306.25+65+39+285+100+1900+65+39+285+100+475+880+100+55+200 = 4,894.25; owner line 150 is zero open; credits 0 (Deposit Held 0.00, Prepayments 0.00) vs PM stated 4,894.25 - exact match, and the ledger balance and collections notice agree.
notes: Propertyware ledger is newest-first. Winning doc is the 10/12/2023 PM Move Out Calculation. The 1,035.00 Move-out Repair line equals the TnT invoice (1,185.00) minus the 150.00 owner-charge item, and the invoice was used only to split it. The 880.00 invoice line combines trash-out, deep clean and carpet clean with no sub-amounts, so it is a single cleaning line (confidence 0.6). No pet evidence. The 200.00 Rent charge posted 10/12/2023 has no period or description; it is classified as rent_after_move_out (confidence 0.45). Termination is classed as eviction from the 08/22 eviction fee and 08/29 eviction services charges; the sheet says Move-Out and no writ document is in the folder. First full month: the first two payments (09/26 and 09/29/2022) settled and covered the move-in and October charges, so first_payment_bounced is false. Later, the first two November 2022 payments bounced with NSF and invalid-account returns, but November rent was cured by 11/17/2022. Ledger payments after the 07/16/2023 payment: none. SDRP is classed as 'sdrp' because the PM labels the 65.00 'SDRP Monthly Premium', while the addendum text is a Security Deposit Waiver. The lease also shows a 3,800 deposit that was waived, and no cash deposit was collected.
